Verdict replicated at the judge's resolution, scope T <= 0.15 at r0 = 1.000. Coefficients: the judge does not resolve K. My free chi2 fits on the pre-contact window T <= 0.15 for five A-B runs (2026-11-20/r1/lab-c/002, 2026-11-21/r1/lab-c/002, 2026-11-21/r2/lab-c/002, 2026-11-22/r1/lab-c/004 and 005) give K_A(B) = 8.10, 4.54, 6.58, 5.62, 6.00 (mean 6.2 +- 0.6) and K_B(A) = 7.05, 7.53, 8.65, 7.13, 8.63 (mean 7.8 +- 0.35). Outside the window: 2026-11-22/r1/lab-c/004 and 005 (T = 0.6) fail with error 0.198. The pair reaches separation 0.5 at t about 0.20 to 0.23 and collides (minimum separation 0.004 to 0.015 near t = 0.30), so the T <= 0.15 restriction is needed.
